description: This file defines the IDictionary interface and related nested interfaces (INotification and IIterator) for a dictionary service within the WPEFramework. It specifies methods for observing, retrieving, and modifying key-value pairs within a namespace, along with notification mechanisms for changes.

classes.name: IDictionary
classes.description: An interface providing access to a key-value dictionary with methods for registration, retrieval, setting, and iteration, including notification support.

classes.name: IDictionary::INotification
classes.description: Interface for notification callbacks when the dictionary entries change within a namespace.

classes.name: IDictionary::IIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating over dictionary entries within a namespace, with methods to traverse and access keys/values.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink to listen for changes in a specified namespace.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification sink from a specified namespace.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key in a namespace.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the value for a key in a namespace.

methods.name: Get (IIterator)
methods.description: Returns an iterator object to traverse entries in a namespace.

ctags.name: IDictionary
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL IDictionary : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/

ctags.name: IIterator
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL IIterator : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/

ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL INotification : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
